Ivy: Quick checkMorning team! Proposing a tiny 'Seasonal Snaps' thread 000-- drop a 1-2 photo of your festive corner (home or desk). We'll do a light vote with reactions. No pressure. :sparkles:

Rohan: Love this. Adding my sad little desk plant with a paper Santa hat. Photo uploaded: "rohan_hat_plant.jpg" :hibiscus:

Bea: GIF: <https://giphy.com/gifs/holiday-cozy-3o7aD6Qz4z6QpQJzva> Also posting my window lights later tonight.

Tom: Photo: (uploaded) "tom_window_night.jpg"  -- small string lights + origami cranes. Low-effort, high-soul. :crane:

Mika: Quick logistics Q: how long do we run votes? 24 hours? Also can we use :heart: for favorite and :thumbsup: for runner-up?

Ivy: Yes 24 hours is perfect. Use :heart: = fave, :thumbsup: = runner-up. I'll pin instructions.
\
event-bot: "Reminder: Seasonal Snaps submissions close in 24 hours."

Bea: Photo: (uploaded) "bea_mantel_cozy.jpg"    -- stockings + ugly sweater collection on display.

Rohan: Also shoutout: if anyone wants to trade cookie recipes, I'm doing a small swap next week. DM me. :cookie:

Tom: Reaction tally so far: :heart: x2, :thumbsup: x1. 

Ivy: Love it. Tiny prize: winner gets to choose the playlist for next Friday's virtual coffee. :coffee:

Mika: Adding 'Jingle Bells' unplugged to the playlist nomination list already.

Ivy: Great vibes. I'll close voting tomorrow at 9am PST and announce in thread. Thanks for making this merry! :tada:
